title: Kissed Uruguayan Floral Tagine
description: A delicate, floral Uruguayan dish featuring sesame seed oil and low-sodium ingredients, perfect for a cozy evening meal.
instructions: Heat sesame seed oil in a tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the sliced almonds and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin and smoked paprika, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the fresh rose petals and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
